day: # The readings of the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (1912; read in the 1909
# Epistles and Gospels, of Old Testament lessons (one from the Historical and one
# from the Poetical Books), of New Testament lessons (one from the Gospels and one
# from the Epistles) and its Table of Lessons for Morning and Evening.
# Columns: see docs/data-files.md.  Misprints corrected (checked against the
#   print by the project's owner): Lent 1, Historical Books, printed "i. 3-22"
#   is Exodus 1:8-22; Easter Monday, Poetical Books, Ezekiel 37:1-14; St. John
#   the Baptist and the Visitation have Isaiah 40:1-5 and 11:1-5 (xl and xi
#   transposed in print); Friday after Trinity 7, evening, 2 Samuel 16:5-23
# The book's rubric for the Morning and Evening table: the lessons for days
# between the Fourth Sunday in Advent and the First after the Epiphany that do
# not occur are left out; from the Twentieth Sunday after Trinity to the end of
# the year all the lessons are read, earlier weeks being left out as needed --
# so those last eight weeks are counted back from Advent here.  (When there are
# fewer than six Sundays after the Epiphany the book moves the weeks about;
# here they simply follow the Sundays' numbers.)
